target.title: fix(qa-lab): runtime parity stays bounded when mock debug snapshots are oversized
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes QA Lab runtime parity capture so oversized mock debug snapshots stay bounded instead of letting debug payload size dominate the parity artifact.

## Why This Change Was Made

Runtime parity artifacts should preserve useful debugging context without allowing a single oversized mock snapshot to make captures noisy or unexpectedly large.

## User Impact

QA Lab parity output remains readable and bounded when mocks include large debug snapshots, while preserving enough debug context to diagnose runtime differences.

## Evidence

- Current head: `c5811043fea8199b58b33d4b86d45629163d96a9`, after merge with `upstream/main` at `b8cdb93f6ffa46f689a9ed799d9543e38228bd44`.
- Current-head real behavior proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/runtime-parity.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/runtime-parity.capture.test.ts` passed with `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 9 passed (9)`, and `[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 47.29s`.
- Current-head diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Existing ClawSweeper state before this maintenance refresh was already `proof: sufficient` / `status: ready for maintainer look`; this update only merged latest `main` and refreshed current-head evidence.
